## What changed?

Describe the behavior and the problem it solves. Link a related issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include a screenshot
using synthetic input. For parsing, redaction, or diff changes, include the edge
case that would have failed before this change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Inputs, screenshots, and fixtures contain only synthetic data.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and a relevant failure case.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior and its limitations.
- [ ] This change adds no unexpected payload transmission, telemetry, or persistence.
